decisions.reason: The app-wide tutorial localization decision is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records the reusable-background and translatable-text presentation format; external asset delivery can remain valid unchanged.

The existing MODIFY adds duplicate tutorial-strategy keys and leaves the prior remote-hosting attribute incorrectly covering tutorials; it should retain remote hosting only for other heavy graphics and record one tutorial packaging strategy.
